name: Bulgaria
contextBlurb: Bulgaria follows the EU MiCA framework. Fiat-backed stablecoins can be issued and used only through authorised EMT or ART structures, with 1:1 reserve and redemption safeguards where applicable.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Bulgaria follows the EU MiCA framework. Fiat-backed stablecoins can be issued and used only through authorised EMT or ART structures, with 1:1 reserve and redemption safeguards where applicable.

regulators.name: Financial Supervision Commission
regulators.role: Bulgarian financial market supervisor involved in MiCA implementation and crypto-asset market conduct.
